translation:
Kabirvad

At Kabirvad, Gyaniji met Kabirji. There Kabirji gave Gyaniji spiritual teaching (upadesh). When Kabirji placed his hand on Gyaniji's head, Gyaniji beheld the form of Ram; and when he opened his eyes, he saw Kabirji standing there. So Gyaniji asked: "O Baba, are you Kabir, or are you Ram?" Kabirji replied: _"Sheeshe mein jo cheez hoti hai, vohi dikhti hai"_ (whatever thing is truly within the mirror — that alone is what one sees).

Thus Gyaniji beheld Kabirji under the combined name Ram-Kabir, and this is how he gave us the name Ram-Kabir.
